description:
Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work.

 
 Job Title :
Product Engineer 
 Reporting To: 
Specialist/Lead, Prod. Engrg. 
 Work Schedule: 
Onsite – Buffalo, NY
 Moog is hiring an Electronics Product Engineer in our Military Aircraft Group for an onsite position in East Aurora, NY. As an Electronics Product Engineer , you will provide technical support for Moog’s electronics products for military aircraft programs through the production phase of the product life cycle. Primary areas of responsibility include supporting production assembly and test areas by resolving issues, maintaining product integrity, and influencing product cost.
  
 Reporting directly to the Electronics Product Engineering Manager, an Electronics Product Engineer provides engineering support for 1-2 product lines, that are typically mature in their production life cycle. However, there are opportunities to gain exposure to program development and new product introduction (NPI), along with production supplier transfers and supporting the supply chain with product delivery.
  
 As an Electronics Product Engineer you will have responsibility for providing technical guidance and working collaboratively in a team environment to support the Assembly and Test operations. You will be expected to provide leadership and be accountable for on time delivery and quality of the product you are assigned. While you may find yourself as the technical lead for the operations team, you will have support from Senior Product Engineers when needed, to ensure mission success and develop growth.
   
 In your role as an Electronics Product Engineer, you can expect to support production by:
 Assuring and maintaining product integrity, quality and on-time delivery of production products. You will do this by collaborating with Moog personnel, resolving production problems, assisting in troubleshooting test failures, monitoring and resolving first pass yield (FPY) issues, servicing non-conformances, performing Material Review Board (MRB) analyses, and assisting in evaluation for possible notice of escape to customers.
 Identifying areas for producibility and quality improvements in product design and initiate these changes and planning for schedule impacts.
 Support the facilitation of design changes by redlining drawings, attending Change Review Board (CRB) and starting the ECN process.
 Establish tasks and schedules for Product Engineering on team-based projects.
 Initiating clear production assembly/test instructions and providing training to operations personnel to maintain efficient production. These instructions include formal Work Instructions, Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP / PAT), engineering memos, and Electronic Historical Record (EHR) entries.
 Provide timely information to all affected operating groups regarding potential problems with quality, schedule and cost.
 Tracking key company metrics including, but not limited to first pass yield, and product cost objectives to maintain and improve our performance and goals.
 Coordinating and interfacing with internal/external customers and/or suppliers to maintain design integrity, producibility and quality in products.
 Lead Root Cause Corrective Action analyses and projects that ensure long-term solutions to prevent recurring problems.
 Function as the customer/vendor point of contact for all technical electronics production related questions.
 Maintain close contact with Moog Program Management to insure “no surprises” when talking to their customers.
  
 To be considered for Product Engineer role, here's what you'll need to bring with you:  
 Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) preferred, OR a relevant  Bachelor’s degree plus, 3 years of relevant experience Focused scholastic research or internships/co-op experience will be considered. 
 Electronics knowledge from the product level down to the circuit and component levels – circuit analysis and troubleshooting. 
 Knowledge of electronics test and measurement equipment 
 Knowledge of printed circuit board assembly processes 
 Have self-starting instincts, solid analytical skills, and a strong sense of ownership for responsible products. 
 Have strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate at all levels of an organization, including working with technicians, customers and/or suppliers/sub-contract suppliers 
 Ability to work onsite in East Aurora, NY on a regular basis (remote candidates will not be considered). 
 The ability to travel, sometimes on short notice, to customers, contract manufacturers, suppliers, etc., to support the product line  - 5 – 15% of the year. 
 This job requires access to United States export-controlled information 
 
 It'd be great if you also had: 
 Experience in the aerospace or other regulated industry
 General knowledge in the areas of Root Cause / Corrective Action, LEAN, Project Planning, Product line transfers and Data Acquisition and Analysis
 Knowledge of quality and production related standards such as ISO 9001 or AS9100D, IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001
  
 How We Care for You: 
 Financial Rewards: great compensation package, bonus opportunities , matching 401k, and the ability to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan (select locations), Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts
 Work/Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, holidays and parental leave program, relocation assistance.
 Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
 Professional Skills Development: Tuition Assistance, mentorship and coaching opportunities, leadership development and other personal growth programs
 Culture: Warm, respectful, family-like environment driven by our 12 core values. Multiple Employee Resource Groups led by our employees, open and welcoming to all.
  
 
 Salary Range Transparency: 
Buffalo, NY $80,000.00–$100,000.00 Annually
 Salary Range Disclaimer 
 The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Moog salary range for this position in the given work location. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range(s) listed is just one component of Moog's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, employee stock purchase plan, an open paid time off policy, and many region-specific benefits. 

 This position requires access to U.S. export-controlled information.

 Moog offers an inclusive workplace, and, as such, affirms the right of every person to participate in all aspects of employment based on merit without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. If you are interested in applying for employment and need special assistance or an accommodation to apply for a posted position, contact our Human Resources department via phone at 844-367-5787. 

 No unsolicited agency submittals please. Agency partners must be invited to participate in a search by our Talent Acquisition Team and have signed terms in place prior to any submittal.
